title.full: Viewing your CPF Yearly Statement of Account

summary.text: Log in with Singpass to my cpf digital services to view, print or download your statements from the past 10 years.

details.heading: Keep your own copy
details.body: CPF does not provide statements older than 10 years, so download them in time and keep a copy.

example_phrasings: how to see my CPF statement
I want to print my CPF yearly statement

sources.page_title: How do I view my CPF Yearly Statement of Account?

quotes.text: You can view, print and/or download your CPF Yearly Statement of Account for the past 10 years via Singpass login at my cpf digital services.
As we do not provide CPF statements beyond the past 10 years, please download your statements in a timely manner to ensure that you always have a copy for your own records.
